title: Database Foundation
description: Establish global Kysely database integration with full schema types and a single migration creating all tables.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts exports Database interface defining tables: organizations, users, projects, tasks
Every table interface includes tenant_id: string (organizations tenant_id represents its own id)
Generated<> is used ONLY on: id, created_at, updated_at, is_active

001_initial.ts creates ALL tables: organizations, users, projects, tasks with correct columns, constraints, CHECK enums, FKs, ON DELETE rules, composite UNIQUE (tenant_id, name) for projects, and all required indexes
All foreign keys enforce tenant isolation via tenant_id columns
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations on application bootstrap

title: Authentication Module
description: Implement JWT authentication with register, login, refresh token, global guard, and role decorators.
acceptance_criteria: RegisterDto has email:@IsEmail(), password:@MinLength(8), first_name:@IsString() @Length(1,100), last_name:@IsString() @Length(1,100), organization_name:@IsString() @Length(1,150)
POST /api/auth/register creates organization and user in transaction, hashes password with bcrypt 12 rounds, hardcodes role to 'Admin', returns { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id }
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
POST /api/auth/login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
POST /api/auth/refresh marked with @Public() returns new { access_token } when given valid refresh_token
JWT payload contains { sub, email, role, tenant_id }
jwt.strategy.ts validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id } assigned to req.user
Global APP_GUARD uses JwtAuthGuard and RolesGuard
Rate limiting set to 100 requests per minute globally

title: Organizations Module
description: Allow creation of additional organizations with an initial Admin user and return JWT tokens.
acceptance_criteria: CreateOrganizationDto has organization_name:@IsString() @Length(1,150), email:@IsEmail(), password:@MinLength(8), first_name:@IsString() @Length(1,100), last_name:@IsString() @Length(1,100)
POST /api/organizations creates organization and Admin user in transaction
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
Successful response returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role:'Admin', tenant_id } }

title: Users Module
description: Implement tenant-scoped user listing and role management.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users with pagination query params page and limit
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
PATCH /api/users/:id/role forbids changing own role else throws ForbiddenException

title: Projects Module
description: Implement project creation, listing, and archival with tenant enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/projects sets status='Active' and enforces unique (tenant_id,name)
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects with pagination and optional includeArchived:boolean
GET /api/projects returns paginated { data, meta } format

title: Tasks Module
description: Implement task creation, status updates, and listing within tenant-scoped projects.
acceptance_criteria: POST validates project and assigned_to belong to same tenant else NotFoundException
POST sets status='ToDo' and returns { id, title, status }
PATCH /api/tasks/:id/status allowed only if req.user.id === assigned_to OR role in ['Admin','ProjectManager']
If project status='Archived' then PATCH throws BadRequestException
TasksController exposes GET /api/tasks with pagination and optional status and project_id filters
GET /api/tasks returns paginated { data, meta } format

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide aggregated dashboard metrics and basic notification listing per tenant.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard requiring authenticated user
GET /api/dashboard returns { total_projects:number, total_tasks:number, completed_tasks:number, overdue_tasks:number } scoped by tenant_id
All dashboard queries filter by tenant_id
Notifications are filtered by tenant_id and user_id=req.user.id

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Track and expose tenant-scoped audit logs for critical actions.
acceptance_criteria: Database schema updated to include audit_logs table with id, action, entity, entity_id, user_id, tenant_id, created_at
audit_logs.tenant_id references organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
AuditController exposes GET /api/audit-logs with pagination requiring @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs returns { data, meta } filtered by tenant_id
AuditService provides method logAction(action:string, entity:string, entity_id:string, user_id:string, tenant_id:string)
Critical actions (project archive, task status change, role change) call logAction
